---
name: link-audit
description: Audit Ventura Roadmap learning and reference links for canonical destinations duplicates and obsolete resources. Use when maintaining or releasing roadmap content. Do not use when deciding whether a milestone belongs in the roadmap sequence.
---

# Link audit

- Check links in changed roadmap sections.
- Prefer canonical documentation course or project pages.
- Detect repeated resources under different labels.
- Flag dead moved or clearly obsolete references.
- Keep archival material only when its historical role is explicit.
- Recheck Markdown structure after edits.
